tool.name: Biomni: Perform Pcr And Gel Electrophoresis
tool.description: Performs PCR amplification of a target transgene and visualizes results using agarose gel electrophoresis.
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.genetics import perform_pcr_and_gel_electrophoresis
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = perform_pcr_and_gel_electrophoresis(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' --genomic_dna '$genomic_dna' #if $forward_primer --forward_primer '$forward_primer' #end if #if $reverse_primer --reverse_primer '$reverse_primer' #end if #if $target_region --target_region '$target_region' #end if #if $annealing_temp --annealing_temp '$annealing_temp' #end if #if $extension_time --extension_time '$extension_time' #end if #if $cycles --cycles '$cycles' #end if #if $gel_percentage --gel_percentage '$gel_percentage' #end if #if $output_prefix --output_prefix '$output_prefix' #end if

param.name: genomic_dna
param.label: Genomic Dna
param.help: Path to file containing genomic DNA sequence in FASTA format or the sequence itself

param.name: forward_primer
param.label: Forward Primer
param.help: Forward primer sequence. If not provided, will be designed based on target_region

param.name: reverse_primer
param.label: Reverse Primer
param.help: Reverse primer sequence. If not provided, will be designed based on target_region

param.name: target_region
param.label: Target Region
param.help: Tuple of (start, end) positions for the target region in the genomic DNA

tool.help:
**Biomni: Perform Pcr And Gel Electrophoresis**
Performs PCR amplification of a target transgene and visualizes results using agarose gel electrophoresis.
Parameters ---------- genomic_dna : str Path to file containing genomic DNA sequence in FASTA format or the sequence itself forward_primer : str, optional Forward primer sequence. If not provided, will be designed based on target_region reverse_primer : str, optional Reverse primer sequence. If not provided, will be designed based on target_region target_region : tuple, optional Tuple of (start, end) positions for the target region in the genomic DNA annealing_temp : float, default=58 Annealing temperature for PCR in °C extension_time : int, default=30 Extension time in seconds cycles : int, default=35 Number of PCR cycles gel_percentage : float, default=2.0 Percentage of agarose gel output_prefix : str, default="pcr_result" Prefix for output files
Returns ------- str Research log summarizing the PCR and gel electrophoresis procedures and results
**Domain**: genetics **Function**: perform_pcr_and_gel_electrophoresis
